capabilities: Write and erase ink on fixed-size paginated notebooks
Snap strokes into shapes and select, move and recolour ink
Annotate imported PDF pages, pictures and scanned documents
Read handwriting on device with Grape for search, titles and links
Record audio and tap writing to replay that moment
disambiguation: Not a general Markdown editor or an infinite-canvas whiteboard; handwriting lives in its own .notebook.md files and cannot be placed inside other notes.
extras: Free, no account, no telemetry; works fully offline. Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later. Grape is described as a work in progress needing more training on real handwriting. Optional network use: Grape model download, template gallery, interface language files, daily update check, and AI requests after you add a key. Do not run InkedMark in the same vault, since both open .ink.md files. iPad tip: turn off Apple Pencil Scribble in iPadOS settings or fast strokes can go missing. Beta versions are distributed via BRAT.
intentEvidence: Handwriting notebooks for any stylus, inspired by Goodnotes
motivation: The author built it as a personal project after tiring of paid App Store note apps, of companies holding notes in their cloud, and of sync problems between a Windows PC and Apple devices.
problem: Native handwriting apps such as Goodnotes and Notability are paid and keep notes in their own cloud, and Apple Notes performs poorly, so there is no local-file handwriting notebook that syncs across iPad, Android and desktop.

relations.evidence: The purpose of this plugin is to be a complete alternative to those note-taking apps.
I was tired of all the paid note-taking apps on the App Store, such as Goodnotes and Notability
combined with the bad performance of Apple Notes as an alternative
FineNotes began as a fork of InkedMark by Pascal Crausaz, and has since been rewritten
Coming from GoodObsidian? Your settings carry over the first time FineNotes starts.
Beta versions: install the BRAT plugin, and add Joost-8/FineNotes.

requires.name: Stylus or pen input device (Apple Pencil, Android tablet pen, pen tablet, or mouse/finger)
Grape handwriting model download (3.5 MB, GitHub releases)
Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, OpenRouter or custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint key
PaddleOCR reader download for scanned PDF text

summary: Handwriting notebook plugin for any stylus that keeps paginated notebooks as plain Markdown files in the vault, with on-device handwriting recognition.
